threads.body:
the common ones we use are `findProperty("testLatestDeps") as Boolean` where this probably wouldn't work since the property is really a boolean as set in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/0ae301eaabd4a280d9a192b5fbfd5f47446572d7/conventions/src/main/kotlin/io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.base.gradle.kts#L30-L31
the other common one is `systemProperty("collectMetadata", findProperty("collectMetadata")?.toString() ?: "false")` wondering whether this could be replaced with just `systemProperty("collectMetadata", findProperty("collectMetadata"))` I guess we could consider removing `extra["testLatestDeps"] = testLatestDeps` then we could use `findProperty("myFlag") == "true"` (I hope this works).
Another somewhat related inconsistency is the usage of `jvmArgs("-Dxxd=true")` and `systemProperty("xxx", "true")`, could decide on one to use everywhere.
